Blocker 1: verification_evidence_add and verification_evidence_batch_add must NOT POST authority before local validation passes.

Blocker 2: when any local validation fails (storyId / itemId / intentRef / note < 5 chars / waiverType-kind mismatch / checklist item missing / etc.), the authority server must receive EXACTLY 0 POSTs. Batch is atomic per-batch (one entry's local failure -> 0 POSTs for the whole batch).

Blocker 3: shadow mode is warning-only. Any authority outcome under shadow mode must NOT influence local evidence state. The only observable side effect of an authority failure is a stderr [warning] line; stdout, exit code, and local file are unchanged.
Blocker 4: enforce mode failure must not produce local/remote fact divergence. At the moment the command returns, local and authority states must agree (either both have the entry or neither does).
checklist.ts authority wiring is REWRITTEN per these invariants; do NOT cherry-pick stash@{3}'s checklist.ts changes (they implement Blocker 1's anti-pattern).

Out of scope: VCP files, stash@{2} koala-vcp-flow-migration (superseded), stash@{0}/{1} (parallel-session leftovers, user-handled), any change to existing post-B-2157 behavior when KOALA_AUTHORITY_MODE is unset or 'off'.
